title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff + regional failover load-shedding
author: Evelyn Park
description: Context: Following repeated incidents of cascading regional failovers and thrashing under an uneven traffic surge, this hotfix tightens SLO enforcer backoff, fixes a race in the circuit-breaker state transition, and corrects per-region load-shedding thresholds so nodes do not over-eagerly fail traffic to other regions. Motivation: production incidents 2026-02-14/15 showed that two simultaneous region saturations caused the enforcer to quickly backoff then hammer fallback regions, causing increased latency and downstream queueing. This change reduces failover oscillation and improves graceful degradation. Changes: 1) enforce stronger hysteresis in backoff so SLO enforcer requires sustained breach windows before widening failover scope; 2) add atomic transition guard and idempotency keys to circuit-breaker state machine to prevent double-transition races observed under heavy parallel evaluation; 3) make load-shedding thresholds region-aware and include a capacity-estimate factor from the placement service; 4) add new metrics (slo_enforcer.backoff_window, cb.transition_attempts, cb.transition_conflicts, region.capacity_estimate) and update dashboards; 5) update Helm chart defaults to safe conservative thresholds and add a runtime feature flag to toggle the old behavior for quick rollback; 6) extend integration tests to simulate staggered region saturation and validate non-thrashing behavior; 7) minor docs update to incidents.md and runbook with new escalation steps. Testing: unit tests added for the state machine and capacity factor, integration test simulates failover path, e2e canary run in eu-west-1 for 30m with synthetic load validated by SLO dashboards. Rollout plan: deploy to canary subset of pods in eu-west-1, observe metrics for 30m, then gradual rollout to remaining regions with 10% increments; feature flag allows immediate rollback to previous behavior. Checklist: [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests, [x] e2e canary run, [x] dashboard + alert updates, [x] helm values bump, [x] security review (no secrets changed). Related: ENG-1984, SUP-321.
